description: This file defines the EditDatasetModal class, a component for interacting with a modal dialog used to edit dataset properties in the Superset frontend. It includes methods for navigating tabs, filling in dataset details, and expanding column rows.

classes.name: EditDatasetModal
classes.description: A component class for interacting with the Edit Dataset modal dialog in the Superset frontend.

methods.name: clickSave
methods.description: Clicks the Save button in the modal to save changes.

methods.name: clickCancel
methods.description: Clicks the Cancel button to discard changes.

methods.name: enableEditMode
methods.description: Enables edit mode by clicking the lock icon.

methods.name: fillName
methods.description: Fills in the dataset name input field.

methods.name: clickTab
methods.description: Navigates to a specified tab within the modal.

methods.name: clickColumnsTab
methods.description: Navigates to the Columns tab, avoiding 'Calculated columns'.

methods.name: fillDescription
methods.description: Fills in the dataset description in the Ace Editor.

methods.name: expandColumn
methods.description: Expands a specific column row by name.

methods.name: fillColumnDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format for a specified column.
